nodes.name: .env
nodes.summary: Local environment configuration for the Spring Boot backend, holding real values for database, Supabase, JWT, OAuth (Google/GitHub), OpenAI, scraper, CORS, AI service, MCP document service, Postgres, and seed-user credentials.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines 41 environment variables consumed by Spring Boot's application properties via placeholder substitution; contains live secrets and must never be committed with real values.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template listing the same 41 environment variable names as .env (database, JWT, OAuth, OpenAI, scraper, CORS, AI service, MCP, Postgres, seed users) without real values, for onboarding new developers.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution guide defining the project's commit message convention, including commit types, scopes, and examples.

nodes.name: HELP.md
nodes.summary: Auto-generated Spring Boot help file linking to reference documentation and noting Maven parent override guidance.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level backend README with a quick-start guide covering prerequisites and running the service via Docker Compose.

nodes.name: mvnw.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows Maven Wrapper batch script that downloads (if needed) and invokes the correct Maven version to build the backend without requiring a system-wide Maven install.
nodes.languageNotes: Standard Maven Wrapper (mvnw) batch script; uses :labels as jump targets for error handling and wrapper-jar download logic rather than user-defined functions.

nodes.name: pom.xml
nodes.summary: Maven Project Object Model for the intelipath-backend Spring Boot application, declaring Java 21, spring-boot-starter-parent 3.5.15, and dependencies for web, security, JPA, validation, JWT (jjwt), OpenAPI (springdoc), OpenCSV, Spring AI, and PDFBox.
nodes.languageNotes: Centralizes version properties (java.version, jjwt.version, springdoc.version, spring-ai.version, pdfbox.version, spring-cloud-function.version) for consistent dependency versioning across the module.
